name: Pathways to Careers (youth chapter)
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors join monthly workshops and a 3 week summer experience. It has job site visits, hands-on projects and mentoring. Students who enroll at Dunwoody can get a scholarship.
who_can_apply: Current high school juniors and seniors interested in a technical career with a 2.5 GPA. Seniors must file the FAFSA or join the MN Dream Act and show high financial need.
pay_detail: Hourly stipend for the 3 week summer experience (amount not stated). Scholarship of up to $10,000 a year for two years for those who enroll at Dunwoody.
duration: Monthly meetings in the school year plus 3 weeks in summer (June 8 to 28 in 2026; 2027 dates not posted)
deadline_text: Applications for Fall 2027 are open through Apr 19, 2027. Online info sessions Nov 5, Dec 3, 2026 and Jan 7, Feb 4, Mar 4, Apr 8, 2027 (RSVP required).
how_to_apply: Send the online application, a one page essay, transcripts and the FAFSA (Dunwoody code 004641). You also have an interview with staff. Email p2c@dunwoody.edu.
notes: Must attend a fall orientation and at least 85 percent of monthly workshops. Selection is not guaranteed.
